claim: In a single burst, an account can launch up to 100 on-demand ECS tasks or EKS pods on Fargate in most Regions. In the Regions the table lists, and in Regions introduced after May 20, 2025, the maximum is 25 on-demand ECS tasks or EKS pods. The quota is adjustable.
question: How many on-demand Fargate ECS tasks or EKS pods can an account launch in a single burst?

values.display: 100 on-demand ECS tasks or EKS pods
25 on-demand ECS tasks or EKS pods
